{"like":["Values high‑quality, sharp, and vibrant visual transfers, especially widescreen and color‑accurate restorations.","Prefers films with strong, likable protagonists and compelling performances.","Enjoys versions that preserve original aspect ratios and avoid letterboxing.","Appreciates additional features such as English language options and longer cuts.","Shows enthusiasm for well‑executed restorations that bring classic films to modern standards."],"dislike":["Dislikes letterboxed or altered aspect ratios that deviate from the original widescreen format.","Avoids pan‑and‑scan presentations and poor DVD quality releases.","Criticizes films that feel overly preachy or lack production value.","Rejects releases with shoddy packaging or misleading box art.","Shows aversion to abrupt endings and inconsistent sound quality.”}​"
